note: 2026-10-24 ADOPTED (the fq benchmark luma PSNR 36.05 -> 37.32 dB): AY/B from the TBC's declared levels (black16bIre 16384 -> Y 4096, white16bIre 54016 -> Y 60160) instead of the fitted 0.67698/13289.1, which lift black by ~476 (1.9 8-bit levels).
